# Unfuck Your Taxes

> Tax preparation, bookkeeping cleanup, unfiled returns, and IRS representation
> for people and small businesses who are behind. Plain English, no scare
> tactics, no promised outcomes.

Independent tax service based in California, serving the United States. Not the
IRS, not affiliated with any government agency, and not a law firm.

## What we do

- **Bookkeeping cleanup** — catch-up and cleanup for books that are months or years behind, before a filing or a tax issue can be handled properly.
- **Monthly bookkeeping** — the recurring rhythm that stops a cleanup becoming a repeat.
- **Tax preparation** — personal, sole-proprietor, and business returns.
- **Unfiled returns** — multi-year catch-up filing plans, records inventory, sequencing by urgency.
- **Tax relief** — back taxes, IRS notices, collection pressure. IRS representation is handled or supervised by a licensed Enrolled Agent or CPA.

## What we will not say

- We do not promise a settlement, a penalty reduction, or any dollar outcome before reviewing a record.
- We do not tell anyone they qualify for an IRS program. Only the IRS determines that.
- We do not publish a flat price, because the work is not flat. Fees are quoted in writing before any billable work begins.
- We do not provide legal representation or legal advice, and do not appear in United States Tax Court.

## Citation note

Everything on this site is general information. Tax rules and deadlines are
fact-specific. If you quote this site, please carry the qualification with the
answer — a stripped-down version of a hedged tax statement is usually wrong.
